procedure: Three sequential neutral-only cases on prepared x86-64 Linux 7.3 host: wired IBEX, single-node Puck and production DualSense control. Separate SDL-only and Steam-only phases, exact hidraw read/write access checks, corrected UHID type/framing acknowledgements and repeated close/removal. Full reduced observations, candidate/patch hashes and commands are in evidence/steam-uhid-host-closeout.json. Passed means bounded experiment and cleanup completed, not that every consumer accepted every case.
semantic_outcome: IBEX bound hid-steam and SDL opened the exact node with neutral state; single-node Puck bound hid-steam with readable/writable hidraw but SDL selected no gamepad. DualSense SDL opened and observed neutral. Steam manual case outcomes are in the evidence table. Wired linux.uhid.usb meets brief 03 kernel-or-SDL criterion. No actual consumer report-delivery or physical-fidelity claim; neutral-only SDL sensor diagnostics are not acceptance passes. Earlier type-2 feature counters and Puck permission attribution are superseded.
